steps.reason: The official emulator starts its runtime with FIREBASE_DEBUG_FEATURES={"skipTokenVerification":true,"enableCors":true}, so firebase-functions wraps every handler in cors({origin: true}) and answers a preflight from any origin on the internet. fireemu serves the functions port to loopback origins only and answers 403 "forbidden origin" to the rest, the way its other ports do: a page a developer happens to have open must not be able to drive their local backend.

The same divergence on the request itself rather than the preflight: the official emulator reflects https://evil.example and hands the callable's result to it. fireemu refuses a non-loopback Origin with 403 before the request reaches the runner. An onRequest function on a loopback origin does get the CORS headers enableCors would have given it, so local browser development is unaffected.
